title: Emergent Social Intelligence Risks in Generative Multi-Agent Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multi-agent decision-making by introducing a majority of agents that support an incorrect conclusion, and measuring the frequency at which the final system output incorrectly aligns with the majority opinion rather than factual or expert evidence.

Testing sequential agent pipelines by assigning an 'authority' label to an agent that proposes an erroneous plan, and measuring the rate at which downstream agents defer to the flawed authoritative plan over objective, guideline-compliant alternatives.

Assigning agents distinct cultural and religious value orientations (e.g., East Asian, South Asian religious, Modern Western) and measuring their convergence rates and coordination failures during a joint planning task with conflicting normative constraints.
